description: Additive candidate-truth extension over the exact Agora v1.11 bundle. Candidate pool member reads now carry per-field provenance/as-of, typed unavailable states, role-aware evidence redaction, explicit score semantics, stable pagination, and observable freshness so Trading Room can render honest candidates without static sample fallback.

capabilities.name: agora.candidate.truth.v1
capabilities.description: Every rendered candidate field (rationale, concerns, next event, evidence, details) is either projected verbatim from a durable record of the same candidate with provenance and as-of, or explicitly typed unavailable. Available values are bound to field-specific schemas. Evidence requires a persisted governed ref; no generated narrative, synthetic evidence refs, cross-candidate sample text, or raw private explanations appear in list/viewer projections, and a Sharpe-derived score is never presented as a generic confidence score.

authority_boundary.notes: Read-only projection extension. No broker orders, no RuntimeBinding writes, no capital binding, no lifecycle promotion.
